Thanks Lisa — received and reviewing attachments. Quick clarifying items from our side so Finance can map things cleanly:

1) Account name exactness: Is the account held as "Marigold Supply Co. LLC" or "Marigold Supply"? This affects ACH matching.
2) Remit preference: you listed remit@marigold-supply.com — is that the address you want Redwood to copy on all payment confirmation emails?
3) PO placement: We can include the PO number in the ACH/wire instruction field (many banks truncate the memo). Can you give examples of how your AR team matches incoming payments to invoices when the memo is truncated? E.g., do you also accept the PO in the electronic remittance file / EDI?
4) Verification method: Our standard is either a) notarized bank letter or b) micro-deposits. If you prefer micro-deposits, we'll run a single test deposit (two small amounts) and confirm back to your accounting contact.

Cc'd Jonas and Marissa from FinOps to coordinate the activation & first payment window. If you can confirm the account name and remit address I'll route this to Finance for activation today.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus — thanks. Answers below:

1) Account name: "Marigold Supply Co. LLC" (exact). Please use that spelling.
2) Remit address: yes, please send remittance confirmations to remit@marigold-supply.com and copy accounts@marigold-supply.com.
3) PO matching: If the memo is truncated we match by ACH trace + invoice amount, but we've had the best reliability when the PO is also embedded in the electronic remittance (CSV/ISO) or the file name of the invoice (we use INV_4567_PO123456.pdf). Sample invoice attached shows our preferred naming convention.
4) Verification: we'd prefer micro-deposits for this account so we can validate the live routing/beneficiary. Please go ahead with the two-test-deposit route.

Attaching updated bank letter and W-9 (same files, no changes) plus the sample invoice.

Let me know when the test deposits are issued and the expected window.
